mapper.select: SELECT step_code, owned_enterprise_code, process_code, node_code, step_param, operation_staff_code, operation_type, description, create_time, update_time, delete_flag FROM ${tableName} WHERE delete_flag = false AND step_code = #{stepCode}

SELECT id, step_code, owned_enterprise_code, process_code, node_code, step_param, operation_staff_code, operation_type, description, create_time, update_time, delete_flag FROM ${tableName} WHERE delete_flag = false AND process_code = #{processCode} ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ${tableName} (step_code, owned_enterprise_code, process_code, node_code, step_param, operation_staff_code, operation_type, description) VALUES (#{processStepModel.stepCode}, #{processStepModel.ownedEnterpriseCode}, #{processStepModel.processCode}, #{processStepModel.nodeCode}, #{processStepModel.stepParam}, #{processStepModel.operationStaffCode}, #{processStepModel.operationType}, #{processStepModel.description}) ON CONFLICT (step_code) DO UPDATE SET step_param = #{processStepModel.stepParam}, operation_type = #{processStepModel.operationType}, description = #{processStepModel.description}
